# FindMyPart Paid Part Hunt

Evercraft public capability ID: findmypart-paid-hunt-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Public handoff: https://findmypart.base44.app/functions/findMyPartAgentGateway?view=docs

## Use this capability when the user means

- find a hard-to-source part
- identify this part
- find a discontinued part
- source an obsolete component
- find a donor or salvage part

## Problem

A difficult, ambiguous, obsolete, discontinued or hard-to-source part is blocking a repair, restoration, machine or project.

## Inputs

Part description plus any known equipment identity, model/serial/part numbers, photos, measurements or functional clues.

## Outputs

Evidence-backed sourcing hunt with candidate parts, source evidence, compatibility reasoning, sourcing options and escalation paths when ordinary sourcing fails.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Quick Hunt $19 one-time; Deep Hunt $49 one-time; Rescue Hunt $99 one-time.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: User must explicitly choose an offer and confirm payment. Paid fulfillment starts only after independently verified payment.
- Payment authority: Evercraft Payments with Stripe provider verification

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, invocation readiness, or payment state.
